fields.body:
## Usage Guide

1. Update README source rules under `memory-api/.rule/rules/**`.
2. Preview the README target with `rule explain-target --config rule-targets.yaml --target memory-api-readme`.
3. Regenerate the README with `rule sync-targets --config rule-targets.yaml`.
4. Validate nearby rule-api behavior with focused tests such as `cargo test -p rule-cli generate_target_collects_rules_from_nested_workspaces -- --nocapture`.
fields.title: Usage Guide

fields.body:
## Common Workflows

1. Regenerate repo docs from canonical rules: `cargo run -p rule-cli -- sync-targets --config rule-targets.yaml`.
2. Inspect or edit specs from the terminal: `cargo run -p spec-cli -- help`.
3. Work ticket queues and board state locally: `cargo run -p ticket-cli -- help`.
4. Expose ticket or spec behavior over HTTP when a viewer or browser client needs it: `cargo run -p ticket-http` or `cargo run -p spec-http`.
5. Compile the VS Code ticket extension when editor integration matters: run `npm run compile` in `tools/ticket-vscode`.
